name.en: Centre for Cellular and Molecular Platforms (C-CAMP)

strategy.thesis: A Department of Biotechnology (Govt of India) initiative enabling cutting-edge life-science research and innovation, with a high-end bio-incubation facility and grant-based startup support.

program.eligibility: Indian biotech/life-sciences startups, academic entrepreneurs; for the WIN grant, startups/academic innovators with TRL-4+ translation-based technologies

investment.raw: Up to ₹1 Cr (Wadhwani Innovation Network grant, non-dilutive)

summary.en: C-CAMP is a Bengaluru-based, DBT-backed bio-incubator (est. 2010) for biotech, healthtech and agri-biotech startups, offering lab infrastructure, mentorship and non-dilutive grants; it has supported ~350 startups across India.
